title: HR Executive
description:
We are looking for a proactive and people\-oriented
 **HR Executive** 
 to join our Human Resources team. The role will primarily focus on
 **Talent Acquisition and Recruitment** 
 , along with supporting and managing key
 **HR Operations** 
 activities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong communication and coordination skills, a good understanding of recruitment processes, and the ability to manage multiple HR activities effectively.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment
   

  

* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, from understanding manpower requirements to candidate onboarding.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand job requirements, skill sets, experience, and team requirements.
* Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, databases, and other sourcing channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial telephonic/video interviews to assess candidate suitability.
* Schedule and coordinate technical, managerial, and HR interview rounds with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process and ensure a positive candidate experience.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview feedback, selection, documentation, offers, and joining.
* Prepare and release offer letters and other recruitment\-related documentation as required.
* Coordinate the pre\-joining and onboarding process for selected candidates.
* Maintain and regularly update the candidate database, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports.
* Track recruitment metrics such as open positions, sourcing, interviews, selection, offer\-to\-join ratio, and time\-to\-hire.
* Support employer branding initiatives and participate in activities to strengthen the organization's talent pipeline.
* Identify and explore new sourcing channels and recruitment strategies to improve hiring effectiveness.


 HR Operations
   

  

* Support day\-to\-day HR operations and employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmations, and exits.
* Maintain and update employee records, HR databases, and personnel documentation.
* Coordinate employee onboarding activities, including documentation, induction, and coordination with relevant departments.
* Assist in maintaining attendance, leave, and employee\-related records.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of HR letters, employee documents, and other HR\-related records.
* Coordinate with employees and internal stakeholders to resolve routine HR\-related queries.
* Assist in probation completion, confirmation, performance review, and other employee lifecycle processes.
* Support employee engagement activities, internal communication, and HR initiatives.
* Assist in maintaining compliance with company HR policies and processes.
* Prepare periodic HR reports and provide relevant data to management as required.
* Coordinate with different departments to ensure smooth execution of HR processes.


 Employee Engagement \& HR Support
   

  

* Assist in planning and organizing employee engagement activities, celebrations, and HR initiatives.
* Support internal communication related to HR announcements, policies, events, and employee programs.
* Build positive relationships with employees and promote a supportive workplace environment.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and HR\-related matters.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in recruitment and HR operations.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end recruitment and talent acquisition processes.
* Hands\-on experience with candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, and offer management.
* Good knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, coordination, and relationship\-building skills.
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and HR activities simultaneously.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information professionally.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Talent Acquisition \& Sourcing
* Recruitment Coordination
* Candidate Relationship Management
* HR Operations
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* Communication \& Interpersonal Skills
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Problem Solving
* Time Management
* Attention to Detail

title: Career Advisor
description:
Job Description – Career Counsellor / Candidate Success Specialist (US Staffing)
 




  






 We are seeking a motivated and results\-driven Career Counsellor / Candidate Success Specialist to support U.S.\-based job seekers in securing full\-time opportunities across IT and Non\-IT domains. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of the U.S. job market, employment authorization categories, and candidate marketing strategies, with the ability to guide professionals through every stage of their job search journey.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide end\-to\-end career guidance to U.S.\-based candidates, including those on F1 OPT, STEM OPT Extension, H1B, H4 EAD, Green Card, and U.S. Citizen work authorizations, helping them identify and pursue suitable full\-time employment opportunities.
* Conduct detailed candidate assessments to understand educational background, technical and functional skills, professional experience, visa status, career aspirations, and location preferences.
* Offer personalized career counseling and job search strategies tailored to each candidate’s profile, ensuring alignment with current market demands and hiring trends.
* Develop and execute profile marketing strategies by presenting candidates to suitable employers, recruiters, and hiring managers while considering visa\-related constraints and eligibility requirements.
* Assist candidates in identifying opportunities across diverse industries, including information Technology,Engineering,Healthcare,Finance,Operations,Customer Support, Administration, and other professional sectors.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of active candidates through continuous engagement, relationship management, referrals, networking,and proactive outreach initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with recruitment, account management, and business development teams to align candidate availability with client hiring needs and ensure timely submissions and placements.
* Track candidate activities, application progress, interview schedules, feedback, and placement status through CRM and recruitment management systems.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with candidates to provide constructive feedback, identify improvement areas, address challenges, and maintain high engagement levels throughout the hiring process.
* Guide candidates on professional branding, including LinkedIn optimization, networking best practices, job portal utilization, and effective communication with recruiters and hiring managers.
* Stay informed about U.S. labor market trends, industry hiring demands, employment regulations, and visa\-related considerations to provide accurate and up\-to\-date career guidance.
* Support placement closures by coordinating interviews, managing offer discussions, ensuring documentation readiness, and facilitating smooth onboarding processes.



  
 



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing, Psychology, or a related field.
* Experience in Career Counseling, US Staffing, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Candidate Relationship Management.
* Strong understanding of U.S. visa categories and employment authorization processes, including OPT, STEM OPT, H1B, H4 EAD, and Green Card status considerations.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, counselling, and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong resume review, interview coaching, and candidate mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple candidates and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with ATS, CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and recruitment tools.
* Results\-oriented mindset with a focus on candidate success, placements, and client satisfaction.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Candidate placement and closure rate.
* Interview\-to\-offer conversion ratio.
* Candidate engagement and retention metrics.
* Resume optimization and profile marketing success rate.
* Candidate satisfaction and feedback scores.
* Timely follow\-up and pipeline management effectiveness.




 This role is ideal for professionals passionate about helping candidates achieve their career goals while driving successful placements within the U.S. job market.

title: Associate Manager
description:
Withum is a forward\-thinking, technology\-driven advisory and accounting firm, helping clients to Be in a Position of Strength in today’s modern business landscape. Withum empowers clients with innovative tools and solutions to address their accounting, tax and overall business management needs. Withum is a place where talent thrives. We recruit only the best and brightest people, with a genuine passion for the business.
 



  





 The Resource Management Associate Manager is responsible for administering the firm's audit, tax and advisory engagements scheduling process, effectively filling resource engagement requests by scheduling, and coordinating the assignment of client service staff to engagements appropriately and ensuring staff workloads are balanced. The incumbent tracks staffing utilization and performs statistical reporting for the firm’s partners and managers to maximize service delivery, for their assigned offices/niches/service lines. The Resource Management Associate also works with firm management and Partners to develop capacity forecasts and monitors all team members’ schedules using the Firm’s scheduling software, Practice Engine, to meet client requirements and enhance utilization and efficiency.
 



  





 Withum’s brand is a reflection of our people, our culture and our strength. Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive \- to be in a position of strength. But our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.
 



  





**How You’ll Spend Your time:** 



* Making decisions on staffing issues by working with all levels within the engagement team to find solutions for workload balancing and client due dates
* Collaborating with niche and service line leaders and client engagement teams to understand their business needs and drive consistency
* Monitoring schedules daily to ensure that team members are being effectively utilized to support the achievement of budget plans by reviewing available resources and facilitating necessary adjustments to ensuring the alignment of resources based on experience, industry, technical expertise, and geography when appropriate
* Monitoring productivity conflicts, leverage, availability, travel, and on\-charge hours
* Consistently reviewing staff schedules for workload balance, managing capacity, and other issues in order to ensure maximum efficiency
* Reviewing potential scheduling solutions, when new jobs arrive or team member(s) leave, in a creative way with a firm perspective in mind and facilitates changes through Partners', Managers', and Seniors' schedules
* Identifying trends to proactively balance workloads while increasing utilization
* Developing strong working relationships and maintains open communication with all levels regarding team member availability to ensure maximum team member utilization
* Implementing six\-month and annual schedules based on established budgets, client requests and deadlines, staff development program requirements, and PTO requests
* Meeting weekly with niche leaders and managers to discuss staffing needs
* Conducting a weekly analysis of the prior week’s posted billable and non\-billable time for the Chief Utilization Officer and PICs, and make staffing recommendations based on findings
* Preparing scheduling, utilization, and forecasting reports on a weekly basis and provides analysis of the data to assist niche leaders and PICs in making staffing decisions
* Acting as a resource and a point of contact to mediate conflicts and resolve resource needs that develop
* Maintaining strong working relationships with managers to facilitate scheduling requests and scheduling confirmations.



  





 Requirements
 



**The Kinds of People We Want to Talk to Have Many of The Following:** 



* 5\-10 years of relevant experience as a resource management associate
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Business, or related field is required
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Strong organizational skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong analytical and data analysis skills
* Ability to multi\-task effectively and efficiently
* Strong relationship management and project management skills. Must have the ability to connect at all levels of the Firm using diplomatic communication, influence, and negotiation skills
* Strong ability to interface effectively with leadership teams, both India and US to come up with proactive strategies on utilization management including busy season strategies.
* Outgoing personality and ability to present topics and run meetings in front of all levels of the firm, from entry level staff through senior and executive management
* Effectively monitor tax work, to ensure work scheduled is completed and delivered. Interface with the US scheduler to ensure work is replaced where there is pending information/ awaiting client information.
* Effectively load balance work in between resources from the same cost center/ across SL, when needed.
* Effectively represent the India team members in the weekly scheduler utilization call.
* Ability to articulate and being solution driven.
* Understands and thrives in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to prioritize work accordingly
* Ability to handle high pressure situations and manage conflicting priorities with confidence by interfacing with the US Scheduler.
* Demonstrated self\-starter who is a solution\-oriented problem solver
* Strong technology skills are essential, including MS Office Suite

title: Senior Executive Human Resources
description:
**Senior HR Executive** 





 Talent Acquisition \& HR Operations
 





 Ahmedabad  \|  Full Time  \|  5 to 8 Years
 




  





*Build the people function that a growing Microsoft consultancy will run on for the next five years. Report straight to the CEO, own hiring end to end, and be the reason talented people choose Powercret and stay.* 

  
 




  





**About Powercret Solutions** 





 Powercret Solutions, a leading Microsoft Partner, excels in delivering cutting\-edge intelligent solutions designed to meet your digital, strategic, and technical business needs. We offer a wide array of services, including customized business solutions built on the Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Azure Solution stack, specifically tailored to turn your organization’s vision into reality. As a trusted Microsoft Partner, we work with businesses globally to enhance their digital infrastructure, boost competitiveness, and streamline business operations. Partner with us to optimize your digital foundation and harness the power of Microsoft for improved business performance.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




**Talent Acquisition, your primary mandate** 



* Full\-cycle hiring for D365 CE, Power Platform, .NET and AI or Copilot roles, from a sharp brief through sourcing, screening, panel coordination and a closed offer. Quality of hire is the measure, not volume.
* **A living pipeline on Naukri, LinkedIn and referrals, plus a vendor network of consultancies, staffing partners and background verification providers that you select, negotiate with and hold to their SLAs.**
* **The candidate experience from first message to first day. You will tell the Powercret story with conviction and lead offer conversations to outcomes that work for both sides.**
* **The last mile. Counter\-offers, notice period slippage and drop\-offs are yours to anticipate and manage, so that an accepted offer becomes a joined employee.**



**People and Culture** 



* Being the person the team trusts with a concern, and the one who resolves it early, fairly and on record before it reaches the CEO.
* **Engagement, recognition and learning initiatives that give people a reason to stay and to bring their friends.**
* **Reading the room. Regular pulse conversations that surface attrition risk while there is still time to act on it.**
* **A disciplinary process that is consistent and humane, from a first conversation through to separation where it is warranted.**



**Performance and Growth** 



* The appraisal calendar, KRA and KPI frameworks, and goal\-setting conversations that give every consultant a clear picture of what good looks like.
* **Working alongside team leads on reviews, career conversations and retention planning, and following through until every review is closed.**
* **Calibration and ratings\-to\-increment mapping that people experience as fair, and improvement plans that reach a clear outcome.**



**People Operations and Payroll** 



* Onboarding that gets a new hire project\-ready inside 30 days, with identity, assets and system access waiting for them on day one.
* **Attendance, leave, monthly payroll inputs, reimbursements, tax declarations and revision cycles in Keka, run cleanly every month.**
* **Employee master data, personnel records, letter templates and a policy library that stays current as the company grows.**
* **HR MIS to leadership on headcount, attrition, cost per hire and time to fill, and a respectful, complete exit process when someone moves on.**



**Compliance and Workplace** 



* Statutory compliance across PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, Shops \& Establishments and POSH, with registers that are always audit ready.
* **Spotting the gaps that come with growth, in policies, headcount planning and workspace, and closing them before they become blockers.**
* **Office administration and asset procurement, from laptops and peripherals to the asset register, so the workplace keeps pace with the team.**



  





**What You Bring** 



* 5 to 8 years in HR, with at least 3 years inside an IT services or consulting firm where you were close to the hiring problem.
* **A track record of closing senior technical candidates in competitive markets. You can talk about specific hires you fought for and won.**

* Handle onboarding, orientation, documentation, probation reviews, confirmations, promotions, transfers, and exits.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave records, shift schedules, and HR documentation.
* Monitor employee performance, productivity, discipline, and workplace conduct.
* Coordinate performance reviews and improvement plans with managers.
* Address employee concerns, grievances, workplace issues, and internal conflicts professionally.
* Conduct regular employee engagement and feedback sessions.
* Support managers in improving team productivity, accountability, and retention.



  






 HR Operations
 



* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, processes, and internal guidelines.
* Maintain accurate employee records and confidential HR documentation.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, warning letters, experience letters, relieving letters, and other HR documentation.
* Manage leave, attendance, holiday calendars, employee databases, and HR reports.
* Coordinate payroll inputs including attendance, leaves, incentives, deductions, and employee changes.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable employment requirements.
* Maintain proper documentation for audits and management reviews.



  






 Operations Management
 



* Oversee daily office and staffing operations during the US shift.
* Coordinate between HR, recruitment, sales, business development, account management, and leadership teams.
* Track daily, weekly, and monthly team performance.
* Ensure employees follow work schedules, reporting processes, productivity expectations, and operational standards.
* Identify operational gaps and implement process improvements.
* Prepare management reports related to recruitment, attendance, employee performance, attrition, hiring, and operations.
* Support management with workforce planning and organizational growth initiatives.
* Ensure smooth communication between India\-based teams and US business operations.



  






 Performance \& Employee Engagement
 



* Establish measurable KPIs and performance standards for employees.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with department managers.
* Track recruiter and staffing team performance against targets.
* Identify underperformance and coordinate Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Develop employee engagement initiatives to improve retention and workplace culture.
* Organize team activities, recognition programs, celebrations, and employee communication initiatives.
* Build a professional, accountable, and performance\-driven workplace culture.



  






 Required Skills \& Experience
 



* 4\+ years of experience in HR, Recruitment, Operations, or Staffing Management.
* Previous experience in IT Staffing / US Staffing is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the US Staffing recruitment lifecycle.
* Experience managing recruiters and staffing employees.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and HR operations.
* Experience handling employee grievances and workplace issues.
* Strong leadership and people\-management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Comfortable working with recruitment targets, KPIs, and performance metrics.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace and HR or recruitment management systems.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information professionally.
* Experience managing performance, attendance, retention, and employee engagement.
* Ability to work closely with founders, senior management, and department heads.

**Job Purpose**

* Govern the performance management process, including performance reviews, development planning, and performance improvement interventions, ensuring effective and compliant execution.
* Support workforce planning, organisation effectiveness, manpower management, onboarding, employee transitions, and exit management activities to enhance workforce stability and employee experience.
* Execute HR programmes and business\-specific people initiatives, ensuring delivery against defined objectives, timelines, and success measures.
* Collaborate with HR Centres of Excellence to deploy talent, learning, diversity, engagement, recognition, and capability\-building initiatives within assigned business units.
* Leverage people analytics and workforce insights to identify trends, recommend interventions, and support business decisions while ensuring compliance with HR policies, governance standards, employee wellbeing initiatives, and organisational requirements.
